scope: Equal-depth verification for an event-dependent arena, a small archaeological remnant embedded in a neighborhood corridor, and a municipal/church pair whose shared civic edge must survive in one frame.

sources.supports: A January 2026 national fitness selection confirms active indoor competition use.
A June 2026 opening gathered hundreds of worker-athletes, proving arena-scale procession and floor occupation.
A January 2026 outdoor exercise program confirms that the venue edge also supports open-air recreation.
The current municipal corridor lists Huaca Julio C. Tello at Brígida Silva de Ochoa as open and connects it to a district walking system.
The municipality identifies the huaca as national heritage and a remnant of a pre-Hispanic urban complex; page date/current condition are not established.
Current destination material places the huaca within a broader lived heritage/tourism network; it does not prove access details.
The current district plan identifies the 1944 Luis Miró Quesada Garland municipal palace as national heritage and separately records church/social functions.
The current municipal tourism page identifies both Palacio Municipal and Iglesia Virgen Milagrosa as active central landmarks.
Official imagery documents the default frontal views whose saturation the scene must avoid.

contradictions: Multiple completed 2026 events prove active capacity but not a future event window or walk-in access.
Outdoor Actívate use and indoor arena events occur in different zones/times and cannot be joined by caption.
Photography, bags and arena positions are organizer/security controlled.
composition_questions: Can the arena bowl, concourse or exterior edge visibly transform individual movement into collective procession or exercise?
Which stage, athlete, banner, scoreboard or crowd makes the frame sports/event reportage rather than architectural causality?
Does one authorized position show threshold-to-bowl distribution, or would separate indoor/outdoor events be needed to explain the story?

source_truth.answer: Coliseo Eduardo Dibós is an active IPD arena hosting varied 2026 sport, education and labor events, with event-specific controlled access.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Arena floor, tiered bowl, concourses and controlled portals gather dispersed arrivals into collective viewing, procession and competition.

current_life.answer: Athletes, students, workers, spectators and exercisers assemble, queue, enter, perform, watch and disperse across verified but completed programs.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Queue, enter, climb, parade, compete, watch, exercise and exit are evidenced. An empty bowl can express latent collective capacity only with access and scale cues.

architectural_causality.answer: Portals, concourses, tiers and floor convert linear arrival into radial attention and collective spectacle; exterior edges can similarly align exercise.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Athlete/stage and packed-event views dominate. The underused relation is circulation distributing bodies before or after the main spectacle.

light_material_geometry.answer: Concourse daylight or arena pools can separate structure, tiers and movement; dramatic stage light without spatial hierarchy fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test authorized concourse-to-bowl diagonal, entrance compression and public exterior exercise edge. Start 35 mm for distribution, 50 mm for procession and 85 mm only with bowl context.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Confirm event and organizer photography policy, obey screening/seating, avoid children/athlete vulnerability, never enter restricted floor and use exterior fallback if denied.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when arena architecture visibly converts arrivals into collective movement/attention. Athlete hero, crowd spectacle or empty-shell portrait fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Authorized concourse diagonal holding portal, tier and floor

B_HABITAR.position: Authorized portal/concourse where groups enter and fan toward tiers

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public exterior reverse where venue envelope causes an exercise/gathering edge
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Exerciser moves between open edge and portal

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Authorized concourse where structural bay shadow meets moving group

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Authorized diagonal joining entrance, concourse and collective floor/tiers
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Queue, turn and assemble occupy layers

contradictions: The municipal corridor marks the site open but supplies no authoritative hours, staffing or interior-route detail.
Tourism pages establish identity and heritage, not current conservation or archaeological interpretation quality.
The small remnant risks becoming a labeled object unless its boundary visibly changes neighborhood movement.
composition_questions: Can the archaeological boundary force a present pedestrian detour, pause or view within ordinary residential streets?
Which fence, sign, vegetation, parked car or heritage-tour pose makes the frame merely inventory documentation?
Does one public corner position show mound, enclosure and neighborhood path causality without an elevated view?

source_truth.answer: Huaca Julio C. Tello is a nationally protected pre-Hispanic urban remnant on Brígida Silva de Ochoa, currently listed open within Pueblo Libre's heritage corridor.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The mound/remnant belonged to a larger pre-Hispanic urban complex; its precise original program is not asserted beyond that sourced scale.

current_life.answer: Residents and visitors walk, pass, look and connect it to a district heritage route; actual entry, maintenance and daily density require field verification.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Walk, detour, pause, look, guide, wait and pass are credible. A quiet enclosure can express protected interruption when neighborhood paths remain visible.

architectural_causality.answer: Mound, protective edge and surrounding sidewalks force present routes to bend around an older urban fragment.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Mound-plus-sign and generic tourist locator dominate. The underused relation is the neighborhood path visibly displaced by the archaeological edge.

light_material_geometry.answer: Low lateral light can separate earthen mass, fence and street; garúa can reduce clutter. Texture without living urban relation fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public corner tangent, opposite-side path section and corridor-approach reverse. Start 35 mm for remnant/neighborhood, 50 mm for detour and avoid 85 mm isolation.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify open status and barriers, remain on marked/public routes, never climb or stage contact, avoid residents/children as scale props and respect archaeological protection.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when protected ancient form visibly redirects present neighborhood life. Mound portrait, sign or caption-only history fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Public corner tangent holding mound, protective edge and bending sidewalk

B_HABITAR.position: Public sidewalk where walker must turn along archaeological edge

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public reverse from ordinary residential edge toward huaca/corridor
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Resident movement intersects heritage visitor path
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No tour pose or locator sign

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Public oblique where earthen surface, protective edge and sidewalk shadow overlap

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public diagonal joining corridor approach, archaeological edge and residential continuation
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Approach, turn and continue occupy layers

contradictions: Official sources verify identities and functions but not a shared event or synchronized access window.
The canonical pair can fail if municipal and church thresholds cannot read together from a legal public position.
Tourism imagery is default-view evidence, not proof of current activity or photography permission.
composition_questions: Can one Parque Central/street position show civic administration and religious gathering distributing the same public movement differently?
Which trees, traffic, frontal symmetry, wedding/event décor or tourist crowd separates the two buildings into postcard subjects?
Does a legal 35 mm position preserve both thresholds and one real crossing gesture, or must the pair be split into separate candidates?

source_truth.answer: The active 1944 heritage municipal palace and 1930 Virgen Milagrosa church occupy Miraflores' central public realm as distinct civic and religious institutions.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The palace's neocolonial administrative threshold and church's liturgical portal frame complementary public authority/community roles around the center.

current_life.answer: Residents, staff, visitors and worshippers arrive, cross, wait, enter and leave; exact service/event peaks and same-frame overlap need observation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, queue, petition, work, pray, gather, wait and depart are credible. Quiet paired thresholds can express parallel institutions only if spatial relation is visible.

architectural_causality.answer: Separate portals, setbacks and central public paths distribute people toward municipal administration or worship from a shared urban field.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Frontal palace and church portraits dominate. The underused relation is a ground-level crossing/choice between two institutional thresholds.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can unify both neocolonial envelopes while movement differentiates functions; low light can articulate portals. Symmetry alone fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test legal park/street diagonal, crossing median and reverse threshold alignment. Start 35 mm for pair, 50 mm if one choice gesture retains both; reject if 85 mm fragments relation.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify municipal/church schedules and interior policy, remain in public space, avoid ceremonies/confession and traffic risk, and kill the combined scene if trees/cars prevent one-frame causality.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when one public gesture visibly chooses or links civic and religious authority. Two landmarks, montage or caption-built pairing fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Legal public diagonal holding both portals and shared crossing/park edge
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude trees, buses and clipped towers

B_HABITAR.position: Legal crossing-back position where arrivals diverge toward palace/church
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Adults cross then diverge toward distinct entries
B_HABITAR.kill_trigger: Action belongs to only one building

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public reverse from ordinary center circulation, avoiding frontal façades
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No tourist pose or postcard symmetry

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Public oblique where portal shadows and crossing line connect both buildings

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Legal diagonal joining central approach, civic portal and religious portal
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Approach, choice and entry occupy layers
